JSON backups, CSV and PDF reports are readable files. Keep them private. Your PIN is local to BizTrack; it does not change FlowTrack.

Private by simplicity.

BizTrack stores your records in this browser. Your PIN encrypts saved records. There is no account, server sync or shared account. Clearing browser data can remove your records. Download regular backups, and avoid entering sensitive details on shared devices.

Net profit means recorded sales minus recorded expenses. This simple cash tracker does not calculate stock, unpaid invoices, taxes or depreciation.

A simpler business day.

  1. Record your sales.

    Add the amount you received and a short description.

  2. Keep track of expenses.

    Record what you paid. BizTrack shows the difference as net profit.

  3. Make a habit of backing up.

    Save a JSON backup to restore your records. CSV and PDF reports are for sharing.

Save your recovery key

Keep this key private and separate from this device. It can reset your PIN and unlock the matching ledger. Replacing a key stops the old key working on the current ledger; older locked copies keep their original key.

Recover your PIN

Use the recovery key you saved for this ledger. Your records will be kept.
